tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: boot screen, canvas behind brand sheets.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Letters inside the mark, text on ignition, tag pills, app icon tile.

tokens.name: deck
tokens.usage: Opaque content area of the app window. Body text sits here in paper or mist.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, hero, pill bar and play bar on deck.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and number badges on panel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers on any dark surface.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted navigation over artwork. Always paired with a 30px backdrop blur. Never used for content.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Secondary text and small labels on void, navy, deck and panel (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Primary text on all dark surfaces. Light ground for the logo.

tokens.name: ignition
tokens.usage: The brand colour and the Store section colour. The mark, Play buttons, number badges, active states. Text on it is navy.

tokens.name: ignition-soft
tokens.usage: Ignition for small text on dark surfaces, where the full value is too heavy.

tokens.name: library
tokens.usage: The Library section colour: active tab, focus glow and accents inside Library.

tokens.name: creators
tokens.usage: The Creators section colour: active tab, primary button and accents inside Creators. Text on it is navy.

tokens.name: creators-soft
tokens.usage: Creators for small text on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Status only: online, in the store, checks passed.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Status only: paused, waiting on the creator.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside small cards and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between blocks in the content area.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; sidebar inset.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Content area side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Brand sheet margins and cover grid pitch.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Number chips, small badges. Also the three tight corners of the mark at 96 units.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, hero, pill bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The app window, the phone tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tag pills and filter pills.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The floating app window over its backdrop.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Hero and large cards on deck.

tokens.name: glow-ignition
tokens.usage: Glow under a primary Play button or number badge. One glow per view.
